title: Hepburn
description: PaperMC plugin, Romaji to Natural Japanese sentences.
body:
# Hepburn

A simple, lightweight PaperMC plugin that automatically converts Romanji (Latin alphabet) chat input into Japanese characters and appends it to your message.

## Features

* **Automatic Conversion**: Converts Romanji input and appends the Japanese text to the original message.
    * *Example:* `arigatou` -> `arigatou (ありがとう)`
* **Player Toggle**: Each player can choose to turn the conversion on or off for their own messages. 
* **Zero Config**: No complicated settings. It works immediately upon installation.
* **Plug & Play**: Simply drop the jar file into your `plugins` folder and you're ready to go.

## Commands

* `/hepburn <true|false>` - Switch the Japanese conversion on or off for yourself. (permission: `hepburn.command`, `default: true`)

## Installation

1.  Download the latest `.jar` file.
2.  Place the file into your server's `plugins` directory.
3.  Restart your server.

## Requirements

* A server running **PaperMC** or their forks.
* Java 21 or higher (depending on your Paper version).
